SCIENTIFIC SCOPE
This is a same-data reward-free learn-then-deploy representation-discovery test with open-loop deployment sequence planning. Non-oracle methods receive identical mixed observations and trajectories. Capability receives the declared terminal task-feature map, not hidden relevance labels.
A positive result does NOT establish superiority over RL, HOMER, BRIEE, MusIK, or B-stable PSR algorithms. It establishes only that the task-relative recursive target is empirically learnable in this synthetic class and can reduce sample cost relative to reward-general/full predictive fitting.

K2: If Full-Reduced-Rank matches Capability, credit generic predictive compression rather than task-relative compression.

K6: Even Evidence Level 3 only licenses Stage 2B against faithful strong RL/representation-learning baselines.
K7: Stage 2A uses open-loop deployment sequence planning; do not generalize its result to closed-loop partially observed agency.
